'''Hundria Kast''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] who served the [[Alvorine Authority]] as chief of security of [[Alvorine City]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Alvorine]]. During the [[Time/Legends|time]] of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]], the [[Hutt/Legends|Hutt]] war criminal [[Krova (Hutt)|Krova]] was captured by the [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] [[Langro Dis]], and the bounty hunter subsequently corresponded with Kast to arrange for the Hutt's transport to Alvorine, for incarceration by the planetary authorities.<ref name="THH" />
